entries.contribution:
As I was thinking through the user experience after observing how people were interacting with our self service booth, it occurred to me that it might be interesting to setup a portable vending machine which collects digital payments and then dispenses the cacao drink or bags of cacao nibs its holding.

Payment methods to support

- USDT via Solana network
- ⁠Credit Card worldwide
- ⁠PIX in Brazil

If we do observe conversion rates via these two manual on premise routes we are right now experimenting with, it might make sense to more seriously look into this

I spent 20 minutes following up with Paloma and thinking through the user experience process

narrative.text: Paloma contributed to multiple projects in the TrueSight DAO ecosystem, including 20250617_agroverse, 20250617_beerhall, Agroverse, TrueSight DAO, and telegram_chatlog, from August 30, 2024, to August 7, 2025. Her work primarily consisted of 17 instances of human effort logged under the 100 TDG per hour category, alongside single contributions of liquidity injection and one additional hour of effort. These efforts represent her involvement in the DAO's Agroverse and related initiatives.
